items.title: Week 3 — Rational endpoints
items.statement: On $\mathbb R$, compare the collection of all open intervals with the collection of open intervals having rational endpoints. Work with Topology Peer to determine whether the rational-endpoint intervals form a basis for the usual topology and to understand exactly why.
items.initial_prompt: Begin by asking the student what would have to be true for rational-endpoint intervals to generate the usual topology, preferably by focusing on an arbitrary point inside an arbitrary open interval. Do not give the proof immediately.
